name: Yaara Sumeruk
bio: Yaara has directed commercials for many brilliant clients, including P&G, Grammarly, Lego, Babbel, Puma, Garden of Life, Converse, Google, Blue Cross Blue Shield. Her short comedy film RINGO premiered at the prestigious Locarno International Film Festival. She’s based in NYC and being the daughter of Argentinians, speaks Spanish really quickly.
